---

## Crop / Disease Details

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Crop species** | e.g., Rice (Oryza sativa) |
| **Common name** | e.g., Rice |
| **Disease name** | e.g., Rice Blast |
| **Pathogen** | e.g., Magnaporthe oryzae (fungal) |
| **Severity relevance** | Does severity grading (G0–G3) apply? |

## Dataset Availability

- [ ] PlantVillage contains this crop/disease
- [ ] Public dataset available (provide link)
- [ ] Custom dataset needs to be collected
- **Estimated images available**: e.g., ~500 per class

## Treatment / Advisory Information

- [ ] FRAC-coded chemical treatments known
- [ ] Organic/bio-control alternatives documented
- [ ] Prevention/cultural practices documented

## Agricultural Impact

Why is this crop/disease important to support?

- **Global production area**: e.g., 160 million hectares
- **Economic impact of disease**: e.g., $5B annual losses
- **Regions most affected**: e.g., South and Southeast Asia

## Additional Context

Any research papers, extension guides, or expert contacts for this crop/disease.
